plate.title: B18 · Fine lattice grain and guided leaves
plate.description: The small mesh receives one contained leaf or narrow leaf images along actual half-diagonal guides. No fan of corner leaves accumulates at a shared lattice vertex.

constructionNotes: The small mesh receives one contained leaf or narrow leaf images along actual half-diagonal guides. No fan of corner leaves accumulates at a shared lattice vertex. Optional curved display selects only intended flowing paths and retains actual roots, tips and seam landmarks; native execution remains finite chords.
